name: strength-and-conditioning
description: Strength, power, and conditioning principles for physical education. Covers the seven classical strength adaptations (hypertrophy, maximal strength, power, endurance, speed, agility, mobility), resistance training modalities, periodization models, age-appropriate progression, and injury prevention. Use when designing resistance units, prescribing off-season conditioning, adapting training for adolescent development, or integrating strength work into sport-specific preparation.
